title: Multi-Agent Coding: How to Run Parallel AI Workers on the Same Codebase
summary: One agent builds the API, another the frontend, a third writes tests — all at the same time. Here's how to run multi-agent coding workflows without conflicts.
body_markdown: It depends on the pattern. For parallel feature branches, agents don't need to communicate — they work in isolation and merge through PRs. For the frontend/backend split, communication happens through shared type files. For the pipeline pattern, agents do communicate — reviewer sends findings to the implementer, tester reports results to the lead.
